messages:
lina (docs): Quick PR idea for the on-prem docs: a compact HSM preflight + airgap packaging checklist. There's recurring confusion in support tickets about missing PKCS11 .so in bundles and device permissions.
sam (eng-ml): Good. Minimal actionable checks please: presence, executable bit, module load probe, device node group and mode, and network reachability for networked HSMs.
maria (security): Don't suggest chmod 666. Recommend creating group 'redwood-hsm' and a udev rule that sets GID and mode=0660. Add a short note about auditd if teams want to record key access events.
aaron (eng-platform): Also propose a tiny systemd one-shot service to run /usr/local/bin/hsm-preflight before the installer so the main unit waits on success. Example in the PR. Include an airgap verify command: `installer --verify-hsm /opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so`.
jules (support): I'll add standardized exit codes for the preflight script (10=missing binary,11=permission denied,12=module load error,13=device missing,14=network unreachable) so support can triage automatically.
rachel (devex): Draft SDK snippet to surface a clear error linking to the doc when pkcs11 init fails. Keep it language-agnostic.
lina (docs): Plan: short callout box in quickstart, full code blocks in a troubleshooting appendix, and example canned replies for support. I'll open a WIP PR and ping reviewers.
deploy-bot: lint: docs/md-lint warning (callout width). Run `./tools/lint-md --fix` before merge.
maria (security): I'll review the wording and approve when group/audit wording looks correct.
all: ack, thanks — Lina will draft PR and update with feedback. End.
